answer: Each identity registers one relic repeater in the atlas, key-binding its serial and locking a 75-credit bond. An auditor sends a whisper test each epoch through it and checks the whisper log against the atlas table; mismatch over 5%, a missing log, or one serial filed twice burns the bond and strikes the serial. First filing costs 34; kth costs 34+6(k-1), so the 1000th costs 6028 and 1000 fakes pay 3031000 plus 75000 locked. A rented-repeater ring fails: the rented relic still carries its owner key, so a renter log under another key mismatches the atlas entry. An honest identity pays 34 once.
